zh: 法语以 être 作助动词的复合过去时现支持性数配合：动词本与变位弹窗以阳性 / 阴性对照展示，并标注礼貌单数 vous 的用法。
变位练习开放 elle / elles 随机出题并加入阴阳性干扰项；拼写模式同时接受 je / tu / nous 的阴阳性及 vous 的单复数与阴阳性写法。
句子测验新增法语阴性主语的 être 复合过去时例句与解析。
en: French compound past verbs conjugated with être now show masculine and feminine agreement side by side in the Verb Book and conjugation modal, including polite singular vous.
Conjugation practice now prompts elle and elles with opposite-gender distractors, while Typing accepts gender variants for je, tu, and nous as well as singular and plural forms for vous.
Sentence quizzes add French compound past scenes with feminine subjects and agreement explanations.

zh: 优化变位练习选择题干扰项：普通时态和肯定命令式优先搭配 1 个同时态不同人称与 2 个不同时态同人称选项，同时锻炼人称和时态辨别。
en: Improved multiple-choice distractors in conjugation practice: standard tenses and affirmative imperatives now prioritize one same-tense, different-person choice and two different-tense, same-person choices to test both tense and person.

zh: 新版就绪提示会显示即将安装的版本号。
en: The update notice shows the version that is ready to install.

zh: 更新日志、版权和版本号集中到设置页，手机答题时有更多空间。
优化错题复习列表：手机端让长人称单独换行，桌面端突出动词和答案，并分行显示复习阶段与到期状态。
en: The changelog, copyright, and version now live in Settings, freeing up space for questions on phones.
Review lists give long pronouns their own line on phones. Desktop tables emphasize verbs and answers and show review stage and due status on separate lines.

zh: 变位练习新增「显示动词释义」开关，选择题和输入题都可隐藏释义，设置会保存在本机。
动词本恢复动词与释义分行显示。时态栏在桌面放不下时可用左右箭头滚动，手机端可直接横滑。
en: Show or hide verb meanings in multiple-choice and typing practice. ConjuGO saves your preference on this device.
The Verb Book displays the verb and its meaning on separate lines. Use arrows to scroll through tenses on desktop or swipe on a phone.

zh: 四种语言新增分词和副动词专项，覆盖动词本、变位练习和句子测验。
西语补充 usted 和 ustedes，英语补充 it，意大利语补充敬称 Lei，法语补充 vous 的礼貌单数用法。
英语不规则动词的选择题优先考查常见误写和易混词形，每题提供四个不同选项。
新增更新日志，页脚可查看当前版本。
en: Study participles and gerunds across all four languages in the Verb Book, Practice, and Quiz.
Practice Spanish usted and ustedes, English it, Italian polite Lei, and the French polite singular use of vous.
English irregular-verb drills prioritize common misspellings and easily confused forms, with four distinct choices per question.
Open the changelog to see what changed, and check the footer for the current version.
